parent_objective: design branch-specific response-history materialization for source interventions
blocked_by: M1278 blocks direct policy training from contradictory current-observation intervention labels
supersedes: direct BC or actor training from M1277 current-frame intervention rows

public_gates: M1279 must preserve actor input contract
M1279 must not use private holdout
M1279 must design branch-specific response-history artifacts without actor-input leakage
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add fault labels or branch labels to actor observations
do not train directly on contradictory current-frame intervention rows
do not claim self-identification from source artifacts

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs branch-specific response-history artifacts needed to make M1277 interventions policy-usable without branch labels
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if history materialization requires branch/fault labels in actor observations
stop if current-frame contradictory labels are used directly for actor training
stop if design skips no-training artifact audit
fallback_plan: if history artifacts can be cleanly defined, admit one bounded implementation
if not, route to source-intervention schema repair or branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1278 identifies branch-specific response history as the missing artifact before policy-side use

admission_evidence: M1278 blocks direct policy training due contradictory branch labels under same current observation
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next implementation manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: design defines no-leak actor-view history guardrails

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1279 explicitly addresses the current-frame ambiguity in M1277 but remains design-only.
history_necessity_tests: future implementation must include wrong-history swap artifacts and distinguishability checks before any self-ID claim
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: History evidence remains blocked until response-history artifacts exist and are audited.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If histories are not distinguishable without labels, route to history-prefix repair or active probing design rather than actor training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A no-training response-history materialization design can make M1277 preferred/rejected intervention artifacts usable for later recurrent-policy tests without revealing branch labels.
success_criteria: design explains why direct current-frame training is blocked
design specifies history prefix and frame schema
design pre-registers one bounded implementation if admitted
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design leaks branch/fault labels into actor-view history
design skips directly to actor training
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1279 passes if it designs response-history materialization and one bounded implementation without training or actor-input expansion.
